name: Cut a raw recording and get chapters and short clips
why: The same run as this kit's long-recording workflow: a timed cut list, chapters and the best short clips from one recording.

name: Cut, chapter and clip a long video into five shorts
why: Works from a transcript to a cut list, working chapters and five clips, close to the edit decision list and clip finder skills.

name: Interview transcript trimmer
why: Cuts a long interview transcript down in passes to the strongest passages, a useful first pass before building the edit list.

name: Social video edit planner
why: A timed cut list, captions, cover and export checks for one social video, for clips that ship alone.

name: Video ad edit planner
why: A timed cut list, caption windows, a sound plan and exports when the edit is a paid ad rather than an organic clip.

name: Cut, caption and check a video ad before launch
why: Adds brand-font captions and a launch check to an ad cut, a second check on caption timing and safe zones.

name: Video caption maker in your brand font
why: Timed caption groups and a subtitle file in the brand's font, for clients who want styled burned-in captions.

name: Get a short product reel with captions that fit
why: A short product reel with timed captions, for product clips cut from photos and short footage.

name: Short video hook writer
why: Ten hooks checked for length and first shot; use it to test hook text before it goes on a clip, keeping only words the speaker said.

name: Podcast show notes writer
why: Show notes from a transcript, alongside this kit's chapters and description step for podcast episodes.

name: Reusable Reel cover recipe builder
why: A repeatable cover style for clips, so a weekly clip batch looks like one series.

name: Monthly content repurposer
why: Picks last month's best pieces to turn into clips, a good feed for the weekly clip batch workflow.
